text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, I lost...!
Made a fool of myself again...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "It's tough when you're small," "You're not cut out for this"... Everyone's saying the exact same thing...!
choice_data_list: I believe in your strength, Taishin!
Let's turn that frustration into training!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: "It's tough when you're small," "You're not cut out for this"... Everyone's saying the exact same thing...!
choice_data_list: I believe in your strength, Taishin!
Let's turn that frustration into training!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
I don't need your pity!
choice_data_list: It's not pity! I truly believe in you!
It's not pity! I truly believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: So it was baseless encouragement after all?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I mean, look, even though I keep losing like this, they still say they believe in me, they believe in me...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well, I just find it hard
to believe someone like you, you know?
choice_data_list: Then allow me to explain my reasoning!

text_block_list.text:
If you cannot believe it,
then I have no choice but to explain and prove it to you one by one.

Beyond the sheer power of her late-race burst, Narita Taishin's fierce
fighting spirit and never-give-up attitude are her true strengths.
Along with how she recognizes her weaknesses and strives to overcome them—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Enough already! You're annoying!
I get it, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...I'll win next time.
I don't want to go through another hassle like this.

Whatever the reason, Narita Taishin's
mood seemed to have improved a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm not about to just sit here
and let them make a fool of me like this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'm blowing past everyone
and crossing that finish line in 1st...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: This is kind of annoying. Feels like I played right into your hands.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Still, *sigh*...
Is that really the only way to win?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Make the training menu tougher.
...I won't accept any compromises.
Though she looked dissatisfied, she seemed to have renewed her resolve for the next race.
